data_description.report_path: Absolute path (e.g. /share). Automatically added to allowlist_external_dirs.
data_description.purge_keep_files: Used when mode is 'Keep N files'. Between 1 and 365.
data_description.purge_keep_days: Used when mode is 'Keep X days'. Between 1 and 365.
data_description.stability_delay: Delay without changes before automatic report generation. Between 60 and 3600 seconds.
data_description.companion_device: notify.mobile_app_* service for the main smartphone. Leave empty to disable.
